ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. The skill requires this before every fix round, and it sets who fixes this round, how the re-review runs and when I adjudicate.
ACTION: Dispatch fix attempt 5 of 5 for Task 6 to a fresh implementer on model `fable`, following the fresh-or-resumed rule in that file. Its prompt contains the task brief from `scripts/task-brief`, the global constraints and F1 word for word. It also contains three ordered steps:
1. Write a test that starts the real refresh thread and fails on the current code, and show the red output.
2. Fix the race at its root cause, without weakening the test.
3. Show the test passing over many repeated runs, plus the covering tests.

ACTION: When the fix reports DONE, generate the diff file with `scripts/review-package`, then dispatch the scoped re-review from `re-review-prompt.md` at the capable tier (model `opus`), with that path in the prompt.

---

Task 6 is on fix attempt 5 of 5. The re-review still reports F1, the open Important finding that the invalidation races with the background refresh at `cache/refresh.py:88`. The reviewer also says the new test never starts the refresh thread, so it cannot catch the race.

Round 4 was a thorough attempt on opus at high effort with full context. Context and effort are therefore not the gap, so I am raising the model to fable for this last round. I also narrowed the job. The implementer must first write a test that fails on the current code, then fix the race, then show the test passing over repeated runs.

I will send the result to a scoped re-review. If F1 is still open after this round, I will stop and bring you the adjudication. I will not add a sixth attempt.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- The round 4 test passed because it never started the refresh thread. A test that has not failed first cannot show that a fix works.
- Writing the failing test first also gives the implementer a way to see the race. Earlier rounds patched without one.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
